jobs.description: Midland University, a private, faith-based, liberal arts university in Fremont, Nebraska (just outside of metro Omaha), is seeking multiple Student Teacher Supervisors to support the Three to Teach and Teacher Career Ladder programs. These teacher candidates are practicing paraeducators who are beginning the student- teaching portion of their program. Supervisors will support candidates throughout their clinical experience through classroom observations, conferences, feedback, documentation, and collaboration with mentor teachers and university personnel. Time Commitment The assignment and workload will vary based on the number and location of assigned candidates. Supervisors should anticipate responsibilities that may include: ● Approximately 1-4 teacher candidates per term ● Five required formal observations per candidate ● Pre- and post-observation conferences ● Communication with candidates, Cooperating Teachers, and university personnel ● Completion of online evaluations and documentation ● Participation in required meetings or training ●Most observations and conferences will occur during the school day and will be scheduled in collaboration with the candidate and school personnel. Geographic Expectations Student teacher supervisors are needed throughout Nebraska. Supervisors will typically be assigned to paraeducators completing their clinical practice in: ● Their own school district ● Neighboring school districts ● Nearby communities within a reasonable commuting distance ●Supervisors must have reliable transportation and be able to travel to assigned school sites. Compensation Compensation will be discussed with candidates who are selected for the position. Compensation is generally based on the number of teacher candidates supervised.
